name: Chili Turkey
description: A hearty chili turkey dish made with ground turkey, kidney beans, and whole wheat spaghetti.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook, stirring to coarsely crumble until no longer pink, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, tomato paste, broth, cinnamon, cumin, salt, coriander, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
Partially cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender and the broth is slightly thickened.
Meanwhile, pour the beans (with juice) into a microwaveable bowl. Microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through. Drain and cover to keep warm.
Cook the pasta as directed.
Place pasta on a plate, ladle chili over pasta, and top with beans, then with cheese.

keywords: chili turkey, ground turkey, kidney beans, whole wheat spaghetti

_similar.name: Chili Con Carne
_similar.description: A hearty and versatile chili recipe featuring ground beef, kidney beans, and a variety of vegetables, ideal for customization.
recipeIngredient: Optional: additional vegetables like zucchini, carrots, mushrooms

recipeInstructions.text: In a large nonstick skillet, cook ground beef over medium-high heat until browned and crumbly; drain off excess fat.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes.
Add cabbage, celery, green pepper, tomatoes with juice, tomato sauce, kidney beans, chili powder, oregano, salt, and hot pepper sauce to the skillet.
Optionally add other desired vegetables (e.g., zucchini, carrots, mushrooms) at this stage.
Cover and simmer over medium heat for 45 minutes, or until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.

_similar.keywords: chili con carne, ground beef chili, customizable chili

_similar.name: Turkey A La King
_similar.description: A creamy turkey dish made with mushrooms, celery, and green pepper, served over toast or rice.

recipeInstructions.text: In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add mushrooms, onion, celery, and green pepper. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Remove vegetables from skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside.
In the same skillet, blend flour into the butter to make a roux. Gradually add chicken broth and milk, stirring constantly.
Bring mixture to a boil and cook for 2 minutes, or until it thickens.
Add reserved turkey and vegetables to the sauce. Heat through.
Serve over hot toast, biscuits, or rice.

_similar.keywords: turkey a la king, creamy turkey, mushrooms, celery, green pepper

_similar.name: Noodles with Hamburg
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground hamburger, macaroni, and a blend of vegetables and cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: In a frying pan, brown the hamburger with celery and onions (if using). Drain excess fat.
Add garlic powder, oregano, salt, tomato soup, corn, and canned tomatoes to the browned hamburger mixture. Stir to combine.
Simmer the mixture slowly for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Combine the cooked macaroni with the hamburger and sauce mixture. Stir well.
If using cheese, heat it until melted and mix into the noodle and hamburger mixture.
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: hamburger casserole, noodle dish, comfort food

_similar.name: Cheeseburger Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A cheeseburger-inspired meatloaf with a cheddar cheese and pickle relish filling, topped with tomato sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: In a mixing bowl, combine ground beef, egg, bread crumbs, garlic salt, onion powder, salt, pepper, and seasoning salt. Mix well.
Mix chopped onion and tomato sauce together in a separate bowl.
Add half of the tomato sauce and onion mixture to the beef mixture and mix well.
Pack half of the beef mixture into a loaf pan.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese and sweet pickle relish evenly over the top.
Pack the remaining beef mixture on top and press firmly.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F for 1 hour.
Carefully spoon off excess fat from the top.
Pour the remaining tomato sauce and onion mixture over the meatloaf.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for about 5 minutes before inverting onto a heated serving platter if desired.

_similar.keywords: cheeseburger meatloaf, stuffed meatloaf, cheddar and pickle filling

_similar.name: Turkey or Chicken Pies
_similar.description: Individual or large pies filled with turkey or chicken, vegetables, and a creamy sauce, topped with a homemade pastry crust or biscuits.
_similar.recipeYield: Multiple individual pies or 1 large pie

recipeInstructions.text: Melt margarine with salt and pepper over low heat. Add flour and gradually add broth, cooking until smooth.
Sauté chopped onion and celery until tender.
Boil carrots until thoroughly cooked.
Mix cooked carrots with peas and the sauce made earlier.
For the pastry, mix flour, salt, and baking powder with butter. Add milk to form a dough.
Fill small pans or a large pie plate with the turkey or chicken mixture and top with pastry crust or biscuits.
Bake until the crust is golden brown.

_similar.keywords: turkey pie, chicken pie, savory pastry, comfort food
